tagline: 柯尼卡数码相机，2001 年发布
description: 柯尼卡于2001年推出的数码相机。配备1:2.8/7.8-1:3.5/15.6 mm zoom lens (like 38-76 mm lens for 35mm film) with 7 elements in 6 groups。Autofocus, 90 cm to infinity, or 6 to 90 cm (macro mode)。

specs.传感器: 1/1.8 inch CCD with 3.34 Mio. quadratic pixels (2048×1536) and interlaced reading system
specs.镜头: 1:2.8/7.8-1:3.5/15.6 mm zoom lens (like 38-76 mm lens for 35mm film) with 7 elements in 6 groups
specs.对焦: Autofocus, 90 cm to infinity, or 6 to 90 cm (macro mode)
specs.曝光测光: multi-field CCD measuring: center-weighted integral or spot metering
specs.闪光灯: built-in, reaching as far as 2.5 metres when lens is in wide angle position
specs.重量: 165 g without card and without rechargeable lithium battery
specs.英文简介: The Konica Revio KD-300Z is a compact digital camera with zoom lens, TFT screen and optical real image viewfinder.
